verdict.rationale: Zero's README states it does not track, collect, or sell user data. That would make an opt-out unnecessary, and self-hosting lets users run their own instance. However, this is a single first-party claim, with no documented telemetry setting, environment flag, or description of what data flows exist. Missing for 10: a documented telemetry/analytics opt-out control or config flag, specifics on which usage data (if any) is collected in the hosted service, and independent verification of the no-tracking claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Zero does not track, collect, or sell your data in any way.
gives users the power to **self-host** their own email app
